proposition.heading: You recruit. We handle Italy.
proposition.body: If your agency sends students abroad, Italy is one of the most cost-competitive destinations in Europe — but the on-the-ground execution is where most partnerships break down. We're built specifically for that part.

collaborationModel.heading: How the collaboration works
collaborationModel.body: You handle marketing and recruitment in your market and manage the relationship with the family. Once a student's Universitaly pre-registration is underway, we take over everything on Italian soil — admissions support, visa file, arrival, and housing — and report back to you throughout.

whatWeDoOnGround.heading: What we handle in Italy
items: Course and university guidance matched to the student's profile
Visa file preparation to the standard the consulate expects
Residence permit filing within the 8-working-day deadline
Fiscal code, municipal registration, and health cover
Housing support: contract review, registration, and scam protection

howToStart.heading: How a partnership starts
steps: A first conversation about your current volumes and destinations
A walkthrough of exactly where our handoff begins and yours ends
A small first cohort, so both teams can see the process work end to end
A formal agreement once we've confirmed the model fits

forUniversities.heading: For university international offices
forUniversities.body: We support incoming students through the administrative steps your office typically doesn't have the resources to cover in detail — visa files, residence permits, and housing — reducing the volume of individual support requests your team fields each intake.
